source_binding: Exact same-repository PR head plus executed workflow SHA; freeze source and release executable hashes before traffic. No source edits or concurrent project builds during a campaign.
mode_contract: raw = literal; zstd = existing legacy prepared configuration; fast-zstd = prepared level 1/window_log 11/no long-distance matching; adaptive = selector over fast-zstd/literal. Config spellings confirmed; adaptive is an experimental candidate, not an approved default.

topology.links: Two isolated veth pairs; IPv4 forwarding enabled only inside owned router namespace.
topology.shaping: Router egress toward each endpoint: netem delay 40ms rate 10mbit limit 256. No configured loss, jitter, reordering or corruption. A 256-packet queue is several 40ms directional BDPs but below one second at full MTU. Retain qdisc statistics and reject unexpected measurement drops. LAN has no impairment qdisc.
topology.isolation: Only endpoint-specific namespace routes. No host route, firewall, default route, NAT or forwarding change. Offloads disabled and final state recorded on all four veth ends.
topology.capture: One endpoint-a underlay interface, both directions, classic Ethernet PCAP snaplen 96; capture starts after calibration but before QUIC handshake and ends after clean shutdown/drain.

dose.fixture_seed: 1729 + trial; identical fixture hashes across modes/profiles; before/after patterned flow uses same bytes.
dose.peer_state: Fresh authenticated gateway pair per arm/profile/trial; three framed TCP objects use ONE persistent TCP connection followed by one UDP smoke flow. Prepared codec/selector state persists throughout. Same test PKI for all modes. No warm cache implied.
dose.warmup: No discarded native trials; first patterned flow measures prepared-state cold entry and final patterned flow measures recovery after opaque traffic.
dose.udp: Existing bounded stop-and-wait exact echo; 5 chunks for 4096 bytes plus final receipt. All return traffic/retries counted. Not a UDP throughput benchmark.

calibration.interval: Before capture/gateway launch for each fresh shaped topology; collect final calibration state and reset/recreate qdiscs before measured QUIC traffic.
calibration.rtt: 20 ICMP echoes from each side to the opposite underlay endpoint; retain all samples and average the final 16 after four startup samples. Require 20 received and shaped mean 75..90 ms; LAN mean below 20 ms without claiming an exact rate.
calibration.rate: iperf3 TCP JSON, each direction separately, 3 measured seconds after 1 omitted startup second. Receiver application goodput 8.5..10.2 Mbit/s in each direction; retain sender/receiver intervals and source version. Calibration is excluded from transfer metrics.
calibration.tc: tc -s -j qdisc show before and after calibration and gateway session on both router egresses; retain exact command/configuration. Configured rate alone is insufficient.
calibration.failure: Retain failed profile-validation evidence and stop; do not relabel it as a valid 80 ms / 10 Mbit/s result or silently rerun.

measurement.exact: Each client and server compares exact byte string and length; hashes bind matching fixtures across arms. Preserve all 256 exact endpoint receipts.
measurement.bytes: Capture includes both-direction QUIC auth, framing, ACKs, retransmissions and observed close/drain. Retain captured IP, UDP payload and Ethernet original lengths separately; excludes Ethernet FCS/preamble/inter-frame gap.
measurement.cpu: Both gateway process CPUs and all application process CPUs separately. Codec CPU is a subset. No nested addition or energy claim.
measurement.timing: First TCP object client interval includes connection through exactness receipt; second/third use established connection and each stop after that object's receipt. UDP smoke time retains existing exact echo semantics. Gateway startup-to-preclose snapshot separately. Harness total session wall includes setup/calibration/teardown as a separate interval. Do not subtract CPU from wall to invent send time.
measurement.attribution: Mixed-session capture/CPU totals are not per-object wire/codec measurements. Per-object application intervals are separately reported. There are two transport flows and four logical application transfers per session.
measurement.statistics: Three descriptive matched trials for primary IPv4 profiles; medians and median trial-paired ratios; no p95 or confidence claim. IPv6 smoke is exact functional coverage only. Mode ordering rotates over three of four positions and is not a complete Latin square.
measurement.acceptance: All exact receipts, full capture/no kernel drops, no gateway malformed/denied/capacity/expiry drops, valid shaped calibration, unchanged host routes, unchanged frozen binaries. Report performance losses and adaptive byte tradeoffs without requiring a win.

custody.private_material: Generated test private keys/config/fixtures remain in owned temporary directory outside artifacts. Public certificate pins retained.
custody.cleanup: Remove only owned process/namespace/fixture state. Keep all formal failures and compact raw receipts. Archive captures+binaries to existing private HF dataset after checksum-verified original GitHub artifact upload/redownload; remove local large copies only after verified custody.

scope: Shaped local Linux TUN/QUIC execution, not an actual Internet WAN or two-physical-host claim. No paid provisioning, new accounts/secrets, macOS routes or large local VM.
amendment: Before any network execution, changed the three TCP transfers from separate sockets to one framed persistent TCP connection. This makes pattern-after-opaque exercise the same per-flow selector state. Bytes/session/trials/modes unchanged; 128 application transfers now correspond to 64 transport flows.
